name: Magento (Adobe Commerce)
description: Drive Magento 2 / Adobe Commerce from any AI agent: products (also per store view), categories, attribute options, stock per source and low-stock items, special prices, orders and credit memos, customers and carts, cart price rules and coupons, guest checkout, and CMS pages and blocks. Bearer admin-token auth, per-store base URL.
instructions:
This connector uses the Magento 2 / Adobe Commerce REST API (developer.adobe.com/commerce/webapi/rest).

**Setup**:
1. As Magento admin open **System > Extensions > Integrations > Add New Integration**.
2. Name and e-mail, then on the API tab grant the resources you need: Catalog (Products, Categories, Inventory), Customers, Sales (Orders, Credit Memos), Carts, Marketing (Cart Price Rules), Stores (Product attributes), Content (Pages, Blocks).
3. **Activate** the integration and allow access. Magento shows an **Access Token** (long-lived).
4. Set `MAGENTO_BASE_URL` to the store address (e.g. `https://shop.example.com`, without `/rest`) and `MAGENTO_ACCESS_TOKEN` to the integration access token.

**Authentication**: `Authorization: Bearer <MAGENTO_ACCESS_TOKEN>`. Since 2.4.4 this needs Stores > Configuration > Services > OAuth > Consumer Settings > "Allow OAuth Access Tokens to be used as standalone Bearer tokens" set to Yes.

**Store views**: requests go to `/rest/default/V1/...`, the default store view. `magento_list_store_views` lists the views and their codes. The guest cart tools take the store view code as `storeCode`; CMS pages and blocks always use `all` (see below). `magento_update_product` writes through the default view, so the values it sends are saved for that view; `magento_update_product_in_scope` takes `storeCode` (default `all`, the global scope every view inherits) for a product change that should not become a view override.

**Search criteria**: Magento list endpoints filter with `searchCriteria[filter_groups][i][filters][j][field|value|condition_type]`, `searchCriteria[pageSize]` and `searchCriteria[currentPage]`. The search tools turn their flat parameters into these keys; filters in different groups combine with AND. `magento_find_carts`, `magento_find_cart_price_rules`, `magento_find_coupons`, `magento_list_credit_memos` and `magento_list_source_items` take up to three generic filters (`filter1_field`, `filter1_value`, `filter1_condition`, ...), a sort and `fields` (e.g. `items[id,name],total_count`) to keep the answer small; they return 20 rows per page unless `pageSize` says otherwise.

**SKU as key**: product endpoints use the SKU, not the numeric id, in the URL.

**Rate limits**: not enforced by Magento core; they depend on the hosting. On 429 wait and try again.

**Tools**: store views `magento_list_store_views`; catalog `magento_search_products`, `magento_get_product`, `magento_create_product`, `magento_update_product`, `magento_delete_product`, `magento_update_stock`, `magento_list_low_stock_items`, `magento_list_categories`; catalog extras `magento_update_product_in_scope`, `magento_list_attribute_options`, `magento_add_attribute_option`, `magento_get_special_prices`, `magento_schedule_special_prices`, `magento_list_source_items`, `magento_set_source_items`; sales `magento_search_orders`, `magento_get_order`, `magento_cancel_order`, `magento_list_credit_memos`, `magento_get_credit_memo`; customers `magento_search_customers`, `magento_get_customer`, `magento_find_carts`; promotions `magento_find_cart_price_rules`, `magento_get_cart_price_rule`, `magento_create_cart_price_rule`, `magento_update_cart_price_rule`, `magento_find_coupons`, `magento_add_coupon_code`, `magento_generate_coupon_codes`; CMS `magento_search_cms_pages`, `magento_get_cms_page`, `magento_search_cms_blocks`, `magento_get_cms_block`, `magento_create_cms_page`, `magento_update_cms_page`, `magento_create_cms_block`, `magento_update_cms_block`.

**Low stock**: `magento_list_low_stock_items` takes a quantity threshold and the stock scope (0 for the default stock). It reads the legacy catalog inventory; with Multi-Source Inventory the per-source stock is not in this list.

**Guest checkout (an order on behalf of a guest)**: the guest cart tools work in one store view (`storeCode`, `default` unless the shop has several views; keep the same code for the whole cart). Flow: `magento_create_guest_cart` returns a cart id > `magento_add_guest_cart_item` per SKU > optionally `magento_apply_guest_cart_coupon` > `magento_estimate_guest_cart_shipping` for the carrier and method codes > `magento_set_guest_cart_shipping` with the addresses and the chosen method > `magento_list_guest_cart_payment_methods` > `magento_place_guest_order` with the customer e-mail and payment method, which returns the order id. `magento_get_guest_cart` and `magento_get_guest_cart_totals` show the cart and its totals at any step. The cart writes and the order placement are installed switched off: an admin turns them on for shops that take orders this way. Before placing an order show the items, totals, address and payment method and wait for a yes.

**Multi-Source Inventory**: `magento_list_source_items` and `magento_set_source_items` read and set the quantity per source (`source_code`, `default` on a single-source store); the salable quantity Magento shows is derived from them.

**Promotions**: a cart price rule (`magento_find_cart_price_rules`) holds the discount; coupon codes belong to a rule (`magento_find_coupons` with `rule_id`). `magento_create_cart_price_rule` needs the required flags and counters shown in its example; `magento_update_cart_price_rule` saves the whole rule, so read it first. Special prices (`magento_schedule_special_prices`) are per SKU, store and period.

**Out of scope here**: the GraphQL endpoint, refunds (creating credit memos), managing sources and stocks themselves, deleting rules or coupons, and B2B features (shared catalogs, companies).

**CMS pages and blocks** always go through the `all` store code (`/rest/all/V1/cmsPage`, `/rest/all/V1/cmsBlock`), Magento's admin scope, so a page written there is not silently moved to one store view. The create and update tools change the live storefront and are installed switched off; there is no delete tool.

MAGENTO_BASE_URL.label: Store address
MAGENTO_BASE_URL.help: The address of the store, without /rest or /admin.

MAGENTO_ACCESS_TOKEN.label: Integration access token
MAGENTO_ACCESS_TOKEN.help: Admin → System → Extensions → Integrations → Add New Integration, grant the resources, Activate: copy the Access Token.

verifyHints.401: Magento refused the token. Since 2.4.4 an integration token only works as a bearer token when Stores → Configuration → Services → OAuth → Consumer Settings → "Allow OAuth Access Tokens to be used as standalone Bearer tokens" is Yes.

tools.name: magento_list_store_views
tools.description: List the store views of the Magento / Adobe Commerce instance (id, code, name, website). A cheap read that also confirms the access token works.

tools.name: magento_search_products
tools.description: Search products with Magento's search criteria DSL. Filter by SKUs, name, status and visibility; filters combine with AND.

name_like.description: Name pattern for a LIKE match; wrap it in % for a substring, e.g. %shirt%.

pageSize.description: Per page (default 20, max ~300 due to URL length).

tools.name: magento_get_product
tools.description: Fetch a single product by SKU. Returns full attributes including custom_attributes[].

sku.description: Product SKU (URL-encode if contains special chars).

tools.name: magento_create_product
tools.description: Create a product. Required: product.sku + product.name + product.type_id + product.attribute_set_id + product.price.

product.description: {sku, name, type_id:'simple'|'configurable'|'virtual'|'bundle'|'grouped'|'downloadable', attribute_set_id:N (usually 4 for default), price, status?:1, visibility?:4, weight?, custom_attributes?:[{attribute_code,value}], extension_attributes?:{stock_item:{qty,is_in_stock}}}.

saveOptions.description: If true, save configurable options too.

tools.name: magento_update_product
tools.description: Update a product by SKU: send only the fields to change (name, price, status, visibility, custom attributes...). Changes the live catalog: confirm with the user first.

product.description: Partial product object: only the fields to change.

tools.name: magento_update_product_in_scope
tools.description: Update a product by SKU in a chosen scope: storeCode all (default) writes the global values every store view inherits; a store view code writes values for that view only (a translated name, a view price where prices are per website). Send only the fields to change. Prefer all unless the user wants a view-specific value. Changes the live catalog: confirm with the user first.

storeCode.description: all for the global scope, or a store view code from magento_list_store_views, e.g. de.

product.description: Partial product object: only the fields to change, e.g. {"name": "Mug", "custom_attributes": [{"attribute_code": "description", "value": "..."}]}.

tools.name: magento_delete_product
tools.description: Delete a product by SKU from the catalog. This cannot be undone; to take a product offline set its status to 2 (disabled) with magento_update_product instead.

tools.name: magento_update_stock
tools.description: Update inventory stock for a SKU at a source. For single-source (default 'default' source).

tools.name: magento_list_low_stock_items
tools.description: List stock items whose quantity is below a threshold: product id, SKU, qty, in-stock flag and low-stock date. Uses the legacy catalog inventory (single source); on shops that run Multi-Source Inventory the per-source quantities live elsewhere and this list can be empty.

qty.description: Threshold: items with a quantity below this value are returned, e.g. 5.

scopeId.description: Stock scope (website) id; 0 is the default stock used by single-source shops.

tools.name: magento_list_categories
tools.description: Return the category tree (id, name, active flag, product count and children) from a root category down to a depth.

tools.name: magento_search_orders
tools.description: Search orders by status, customer e-mail and creation date window: increment id, state, totals, items, addresses and payment. Pages with pageSize and currentPage.

status.description: pending, processing, complete, closed, canceled, holded.

created_at_from.description: ISO 8601; orders created after this time.

created_at_to.description: ISO 8601; orders created before this time.

tools.name: magento_get_order
tools.description: Fetch one order by ID with billing/shipping addresses, items[], status history.

tools.name: magento_cancel_order
tools.description: Cancel an order (only valid in pending/processing status). Returns true on success.

tools.name: magento_create_guest_cart
tools.description: Start a new empty guest cart (a quote, not yet an order) in a store view and return its cart id for the other guest cart tools. Installed switched off together with the rest of the cart flow.

storeCode.description: Store view code the cart belongs to (prices, currency and language of that view), from magento_list_store_views, e.g. default. Use the same code for every call on one cart.

tools.name: magento_get_guest_cart
tools.description: Read a guest cart: items (SKU, name, qty, price, item id), customer e-mail, addresses, currency and whether it is still active (false once an order was placed from it).

storeCode.description: Store view code the cart belongs to (prices, currency and language of that view), from magento_list_store_views, e.g. default. Use the same code for every call on one cart.

cartId.description: The guest cart id (a 32-character masked id) returned by magento_create_guest_cart.

tools.name: magento_add_guest_cart_item
tools.description: Add a product to a guest cart by SKU and quantity. Simple products only need sku and qty; a configurable or bundle product also needs product_option with the chosen options. Returns the cart item with its price. Installed switched off.

storeCode.description: Store view code the cart belongs to (prices, currency and language of that view), from magento_list_store_views, e.g. default. Use the same code for every call on one cart.

cartId.description: The guest cart id (a 32-character masked id) returned by magento_create_guest_cart.

product_option.description: Only for configurable or bundle products, e.g. {"extension_attributes": {"configurable_item_options": [{"option_id": "93", "option_value": 52}]}}.

tools.name: magento_apply_guest_cart_coupon
tools.description: Apply a coupon (discount) code to a guest cart; Magento answers 404 when the code does not exist or does not apply. Check the discount with magento_get_guest_cart_totals. Installed switched off.

storeCode.description: Store view code the cart belongs to (prices, currency and language of that view), from magento_list_store_views, e.g. default. Use the same code for every call on one cart.

cartId.description: The guest cart id (a 32-character masked id) returned by magento_create_guest_cart.

tools.name: magento_estimate_guest_cart_shipping
tools.description: List the shipping methods and prices available for a guest cart to an address: carrier_code, method_code, amount and availability. Pass the codes to magento_set_guest_cart_shipping. Read-only although it is a POST.

storeCode.description: Store view code the cart belongs to (prices, currency and language of that view), from magento_list_store_views, e.g. default. Use the same code for every call on one cart.

cartId.description: The guest cart id (a 32-character masked id) returned by magento_create_guest_cart.

address.description: Destination; country_id is enough for a rough estimate, add postcode and region for an exact one. Address object: {"firstname": "...", "lastname": "...", "street": ["..."], "city": "...", "postcode": "...", "country_id": "NL", "region": "...", "telephone": "...", "email": "..."}.

tools.name: magento_set_guest_cart_shipping
tools.description: Set the shipping address, billing address and shipping method of a guest cart. Returns the payment methods available and the totals. Installed switched off.

storeCode.description: Store view code the cart belongs to (prices, currency and language of that view), from magento_list_store_views, e.g. default. Use the same code for every call on one cart.

cartId.description: The guest cart id (a 32-character masked id) returned by magento_create_guest_cart.

addressInformation.description: {"shipping_address": {...}, "billing_address": {...}, "shipping_carrier_code": "flatrate", "shipping_method_code": "flatrate"}. The codes come from magento_estimate_guest_cart_shipping. Address object: {"firstname": "...", "lastname": "...", "street": ["..."], "city": "...", "postcode": "...", "country_id": "NL", "region": "...", "telephone": "...", "email": "..."}.

tools.name: magento_list_guest_cart_payment_methods
tools.description: List the payment methods the guest cart can use (code and title, e.g. checkmo, banktransfer, cashondelivery, free). Available once the shipping information is set.

storeCode.description: Store view code the cart belongs to (prices, currency and language of that view), from magento_list_store_views, e.g. default. Use the same code for every call on one cart.

cartId.description: The guest cart id (a 32-character masked id) returned by magento_create_guest_cart.

tools.name: magento_get_guest_cart_totals
tools.description: Read the totals of a guest cart: subtotal, discount (with the applied coupon), shipping, tax and grand total per item and overall, in the store view's currency.

storeCode.description: Store view code the cart belongs to (prices, currency and language of that view), from magento_list_store_views, e.g. default. Use the same code for every call on one cart.

cartId.description: The guest cart id (a 32-character masked id) returned by magento_create_guest_cart.

tools.name: magento_place_guest_order
tools.description: Place the order from a guest cart: sets the customer e-mail, payment method and billing address and turns the cart into a real order, which Magento confirms to the customer by e-mail. Returns the order id (use magento_get_order). Creates a binding order: installed switched off. Show the items, totals, address and payment method to the user and wait for a yes.

storeCode.description: Store view code the cart belongs to (prices, currency and language of that view), from magento_list_store_views, e.g. default. Use the same code for every call on one cart.

cartId.description: The guest cart id (a 32-character masked id) returned by magento_create_guest_cart.

billingAddress.description: Billing address, if not set with the shipping information. Address object: {"firstname": "...", "lastname": "...", "street": ["..."], "city": "...", "postcode": "...", "country_id": "NL", "region": "...", "telephone": "...", "email": "..."}.

tools.name: magento_search_customers
tools.description: Search customers by e-mail or a part of the first or last name: id, name, e-mail, group, addresses and creation date.

tools.name: magento_get_customer
tools.description: Return one customer by numeric id with name, e-mail, group, default billing and shipping addresses and custom attributes.

tools.name: magento_find_carts
tools.description: Search shopping carts (quotes) of the store, for example open carts with items to follow up abandoned baskets: cart id, active flag, customer, item count, items with SKU, quantity and price, totals and dates. Filter e.g. is_active eq 1 and items_count gt 0 and updated_at gteq a date. Carts carry customer names and addresses; use fields to keep only what is needed.

filter1_field.description: Field of filter 1, e.g. is_active (1 open), customer_email, items_count (gt 0), updated_at (gteq 2026-10-01 00:00:00).

filter1_value.description: Value of filter 1; with like wrap it in %, with in separate values by commas.

filter1_condition.description: Comparison of filter 1; Magento uses eq when left out.

filter2_field.description: Field of filter 2; filters combine with AND.

filter2_value.description: Value of filter 2; with like wrap it in %, with in separate values by commas.

filter2_condition.description: Comparison of filter 2; Magento uses eq when left out.

filter3_field.description: Field of filter 3; filters combine with AND.

filter3_value.description: Value of filter 3; with like wrap it in %, with in separate values by commas.

filter3_condition.description: Comparison of filter 3; Magento uses eq when left out.

sort_field.description: Field to sort by, e.g. updated_at.

fields.description: Optional field list to keep the answer small, e.g. items[id,name],total_count.

tools.name: magento_find_cart_price_rules
tools.description: Search cart price rules (sales rules: discounts and coupon campaigns): rule id, name, active flag, websites, customer groups, dates, action (by_percent, by_fixed, cart_fixed, buy_x_get_y), discount amount, coupon type, usage limits and conditions.

filter1_field.description: Field of filter 1, e.g. is_active, name (like %summer%), coupon_type, rule_id.

filter1_value.description: Value of filter 1; with like wrap it in %, with in separate values by commas.

filter1_condition.description: Comparison of filter 1; Magento uses eq when left out.

filter2_field.description: Field of filter 2; filters combine with AND.

filter2_value.description: Value of filter 2; with like wrap it in %, with in separate values by commas.

filter2_condition.description: Comparison of filter 2; Magento uses eq when left out.

sort_field.description: Field to sort by, e.g. updated_at.

fields.description: Optional field list to keep the answer small, e.g. items[id,name],total_count.

tools.name: magento_get_cart_price_rule
tools.description: Get one cart price rule by id with all its fields, conditions and action conditions. Read it before magento_update_cart_price_rule.

tools.name: magento_find_coupons
tools.description: Search coupon codes: coupon id, rule id, code, usage limit, uses per customer, times used, expiration and whether it is the rule's primary coupon. Filter by rule_id to list the codes of one rule.

filter1_field.description: Field of filter 1, e.g. rule_id, code, times_used.

filter1_value.description: Value of filter 1; with like wrap it in %, with in separate values by commas.

filter1_condition.description: Comparison of filter 1; Magento uses eq when left out.

filter2_field.description: Field of filter 2; filters combine with AND.

filter2_value.description: Value of filter 2; with like wrap it in %, with in separate values by commas.

filter2_condition.description: Comparison of filter 2; Magento uses eq when left out.

sort_field.description: Field to sort by, e.g. updated_at.

fields.description: Optional field list to keep the answer small, e.g. items[id,name],total_count.

tools.name: magento_get_special_prices
tools.description: Get the scheduled special prices of products by SKU: price, store id and the from and to dates. Magento refuses the whole call when one SKU does not exist.

tools.name: magento_list_credit_memos
tools.description: Search credit memos (refund documents): entity id, increment id, order id, state, totals refunded, adjustments, items and dates. Filter e.g. order_id eq 42 or created_at gteq a date.

filter1_field.description: Field of filter 1, e.g. order_id, created_at (gteq 2026-10-01 00:00:00), state.

filter1_value.description: Value of filter 1; with like wrap it in %, with in separate values by commas.

filter1_condition.description: Comparison of filter 1; Magento uses eq when left out.

filter2_field.description: Field of filter 2; filters combine with AND.

filter2_value.description: Value of filter 2; with like wrap it in %, with in separate values by commas.

filter2_condition.description: Comparison of filter 2; Magento uses eq when left out.

sort_field.description: Field to sort by, e.g. updated_at.

fields.description: Optional field list to keep the answer small, e.g. items[id,name],total_count.

tools.name: magento_get_credit_memo
tools.description: Get one credit memo by entity id: order, state, refunded totals, shipping and adjustments, items with SKU, quantity and amounts, and comments.

tools.name: magento_list_attribute_options
tools.description: List the options of a select or multiselect product attribute (e.g. color, size, manufacturer): label and value (the option id to put in a product's custom_attributes).

tools.name: magento_list_source_items
tools.description: List Multi-Source Inventory stock per source: SKU, source code, quantity and status (1 in stock, 0 out of stock). Filter by sku or source_code. Works only on stores that use Multi-Source Inventory.

filter1_field.description: Field of filter 1, e.g. sku, source_code, status.

filter1_value.description: Value of filter 1; with like wrap it in %, with in separate values by commas.

filter1_condition.description: Comparison of filter 1; Magento uses eq when left out.

filter2_field.description: Field of filter 2; filters combine with AND.

filter2_value.description: Value of filter 2; with like wrap it in %, with in separate values by commas.

filter2_condition.description: Comparison of filter 2; Magento uses eq when left out.

sort_field.description: Field to sort by, e.g. updated_at.

fields.description: Optional field list to keep the answer small, e.g. items[id,name],total_count.

tools.name: magento_create_cart_price_rule
tools.description: Create a cart price rule (a discount, optionally with coupons). Magento requires the flags and counters listed in the rule example. Show the user the rule (who, what discount, which dates) and confirm before calling. Returns the rule with its rule_id; add codes with magento_add_coupon_code or magento_generate_coupon_codes.

rule.description: Cart price rule fields, e.g. {"name": "Autumn 10%", "is_active": true, "website_ids": [1], "customer_group_ids": [0, 1], "coupon_type": "SPECIFIC_COUPON", "simple_action": "by_percent", "discount_amount": 10, "uses_per_customer": 0, "uses_per_coupon": 0, "from_date": "2026-11-01", "to_date": "2026-11-30", "stop_rules_processing": false, "is_advanced": true, "sort_order": 0, "discount_step": 0, "apply_to_shipping": false, "times_used": 0, "is_rss": false, "use_auto_generation": false}. coupon_type is NO_COUPON, SPECIFIC_COUPON or AUTO; simple_action is by_percent, by_fixed, cart_fixed or buy_x_get_y.

tools.name: magento_update_cart_price_rule
tools.description: Change a cart price rule, e.g. its dates, discount or active flag. Magento saves the rule object sent: read it with magento_get_cart_price_rule and send it back with the changes. Show the user the change and confirm before calling.

rule.description: The rule with the changes, including its rule_id.

tools.name: magento_add_coupon_code
tools.description: Add one coupon code to a cart price rule with coupon type SPECIFIC_COUPON and auto generation on, or replace its main code. Show the user the code and confirm before calling.

is_primary.description: true to make it the rule's main code.

tools.name: magento_generate_coupon_codes
tools.description: Generate a batch of unique coupon codes for a cart price rule whose coupon type is AUTO (or SPECIFIC_COUPON with auto generation on). Returns the codes. Show the user the rule and quantity and confirm before calling.

length.description: Code length without prefix and suffix.

tools.name: magento_schedule_special_prices
tools.description: Add or update special prices of products for a store and period. Each entry needs sku, price, store_id (0 for all) and price_from and price_to (Y-m-d H:i:s). Invalid entries are skipped and listed in the answer; an empty list means all were saved. Show the user every SKU with its price and dates and confirm before calling.

tools.name: magento_add_attribute_option
tools.description: Add an option to a select or multiselect product attribute, e.g. a new color. Returns the new option id. Show the user the option and confirm before calling.

tools.name: magento_set_source_items
tools.description: Set the stock of SKUs per Multi-Source Inventory source: quantity and status (1 in stock, 0 out of stock) for each sku and source_code pair. The quantity replaces the current one. Show the user the changes and confirm before calling.

tools.name: magento_search_cms_pages
tools.description: Search CMS pages (content pages such as about-us, shipping, terms) with id, identifier (URL key), title, active flag, meta data and the HTML content. Without a filter it pages through all pages. Example filter: field identifier, value %shipping%, condition_type like.

field.description: Field to filter on, e.g. identifier, title, is_active, page_id.

value.description: Filter value; with condition_type like wrap it in %, e.g. %shipping%.

tools.name: magento_get_cms_page
tools.description: Read one CMS page by its numeric id, including the full HTML content, layout and meta data.

tools.name: magento_search_cms_blocks
tools.description: Search CMS blocks (reusable content such as header, footer and homepage banners) with id, identifier, title, active flag and the HTML content. Example filter: field identifier, value %footer%, condition_type like.

field.description: Field to filter on, e.g. identifier, title, is_active, block_id.

value.description: Filter value; with condition_type like wrap it in %.

tools.name: magento_get_cms_block
tools.description: Read one CMS block by its numeric id, including the full HTML content.

tools.name: magento_create_cms_page
tools.description:
Create a CMS page. page is {"identifier": "url-key", "title": "...", "content": "

HTML

", "active": true, "page_layout": "1column", "meta_title": "...", "meta_description": "..."}. The page goes live on the storefront when active is true. Installed switched off.

page.description: The page fields, as described above. identifier and title are required.

tools.name: magento_update_cms_page
tools.description:
Change a CMS page. Read it first with magento_get_cms_page and send page with its id, identifier and title plus the fields to change, e.g. {"id": 5, "identifier": "shipping", "title": "Shipping", "content": "

...

"}. Changes are live on the storefront at once (after the page cache refreshes). Installed switched off.

page.description: The page fields: id, identifier and title always, then what changes.

tools.description:
Create a CMS block. block is {"identifier": "...", "title": "...", "content": "
HTML
", "active": true}. A block only shows where a layout or widget references its identifier. Installed switched off.
